author: thomreis
body:
#### PR description:

This PR upgrades the Phase 2 TP spike tagger LD algorithm to calculate the spike tag not only for BX0 but also for all BX > 0 for which the input digis are available and for which there is space in the output TP digis.

#### PR validation:

Passes 34434.612 with the spike tags being calculated up to BX+2 in the validation histograms, as expected for the given input digis.
title: Calculate LD spike tag for BX > 0 and store them in the ECAL TP digis
